units.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python reads .one files and converts them to .pdf. It exposes classes such as Document, Page, RichText, Image, Table, AttachedFile, and NoteTag to inspect and manipulate document content. The product supports saving documents using SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions, and it provides access to text runs, tags, and number lists through its object model.

It reads .one files from a file path or binary stream into a document object model using the aspose.note.Document class, detecting the format automatically via aspose.note.FileFormat without requiring Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

It traverses the document tree using CompositeNode.GetChildNodes for type-based node search or the DocumentVisitor pattern to visit Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes, exposing parent-child relationships through Node.Document and Node.ParentNode.

It extracts rich text content with per-run formatting by iterating TextRun objects within RichText, reading run text and style properties such as bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font, color, and hyperlinks via TextStyle.
It exports pages to .pdf files using SaveFormat.Pdf and PdfSaveOptions, supporting page range control through PageIndex and PageCount options.
It extracts embedded images and attached files by accessing their raw bytes, file names, and metadata through the Image and AttachedFile classes, enabling direct saving to disk.

It inspects tables through Table, TableRow, TableCell, and TableColumn objects, OneNote tags via NoteTag attached to text, images, and tables, and numbered lists through NumberList properties on OutlineElement nodes.
It supports page history and revision metadata by exposing PageHistory through Document.GetPageHistory and providing page-level metadata such as Title, Author, CreationTime, and Level.
This example loads a OneNote file and exports it to PDF using the Save method with SaveFormat.Pdf.
This example opens a OneNote file in binary mode, loads it into a Document object, and prints its DisplayName and page count.
The following workflows demonstrate reading embedded content, traversing structures, inspecting tags and hyperlinks, exporting to PDF, and counting nodes.
Save embedded images to disk.
Traverse tables and extract cell text.
Extract attached files from a document.
Inspect OneNote tags and their status.
Count document nodes using a visitor.
Extract all text from rich text nodes.
Export to PDF with custom options.
Extract hyperlinks and their addresses.
Inspect numbered list formatting properties.

The primary entry point is aspose.note.Document, which loads a .one file and exposes its pages as a tree of Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes; Document.Save() is the sole write path, currently limited to PDF via aspose.note.saving.

The aspose.note.Document class loads a .one file and provides access to its pages through iteration, with Document.GetPageHistory() returning a PageHistory for the first page, and Document.Save() writing the document to PDF using SaveFormat.Pdf.

The aspose.note.RichText class holds formatted text content with properties such as Text, TextRuns, Alignment, and ParagraphStyle, and supports operations like Append, Insert, Remove, and Trim to modify its content.

The aspose.note.Image class represents an image node with properties like Bytes, FileName, Format, and Alignment, and aspose.note.AttachedFile represents an attached file with properties such as FileName, DisplayName, and Bytes.
The aspose.note.Table class organizes content in rows and cells, with TableRow and TableCell providing access to their child nodes and formatting properties such as Style and Text.
The aspose.note.SaveFormat enumeration currently supports only Pdf, and aspose.note.saving provides the PdfSaveOptions class used by Document.Save() to control PDF export behavior.
It adds full read/write support (including writing OneNote files back out), broader format conversion, and wider OneNote compatibility beyond what this free edition covers.
AttachedFile class holds the file bytes, file name, and tags of an attached file.
Document class represents a OneNote document and provides methods to detect layout changes, get page history, and save the document.
DocumentVisitor class provides methods to visit document, page, outline, outline element, rich text, image, and title nodes.
FileCorruptedException class represents an error raised when a file is corrupted.
FileFormat enum lists the OneNote2007, OneNote2010, OneNoteOnline, and Unknown file formats.
HorizontalAlignment enum lists the Left, Center, and Right horizontal alignment values.
Image class holds the image bytes, file name, file path, format, original dimensions, and alignment, and provides a method to replace the image.
IncorrectDocumentStructureException class represents an error raised when a document structure is incorrect.
IncorrectPasswordException class represents an error raised when a password is incorrect.
License class provides a method to set the license.
LoadOptions class holds options for loading a document.
Metered class provides a method to set the metered key.
Node class provides methods to accept a visitor, and read-only properties for the document and parent node.
NodeType enum lists the AttachedFile, Document, Image, Outline, OutlineElement, Page, RichText, and Table node types.
NoteTag class provides methods to create musical note, question mark, and yellow star tags, and holds completed time, creation time, font color, highlight, and icon.
NumberList class provides a method to get the number list header.
Outline class represents an outline node.
OutlineElement class represents an outline element node.
Page class represents a page node and provides a method to clone the page.
PageHistory class provides methods to add, remove, clear, and access pages, and its IsReadOnly property always returns False.
ParagraphStyle class provides a method to get the default style and a read-only property for font style.
RichText class provides methods to append, insert, clear, and replace text, and holds alignment and title date information.
SaveFormat enum lists the Pdf save format.
Table class holds the table columns and tags.
TableCell class represents a table cell node.
TableColumn class represents a table column.
TableRow class represents a table row node.
TagStatus enum lists the Completed, Disabled, and Open tag statuses.
TextRun class represents a text run node.
TextStyle class provides methods to get default styles and holds font color, font name, font size, and font style.
Title class holds the title text, title date, and title time.
UnsupportedFileFormatException class represents an error raised when a file format is unsupported and holds the unsupported file format.
UnsupportedSaveFormatException class represents an error raised when a save format is unsupported.
AsposeNoteError class is the base exception class for Aspose.Note errors.
CompositeNode class provides methods to append, insert, and remove child nodes, and read-only properties for first and last child.
PdfSaveOptions class holds options for saving a document to PDF.
SaveOptions class provides a read-only property for the save format and raises TypeError on initialization.
